statement: Suppose fn satisfies the preceding bounds and has weak cylinder limit F. Choose a subsequence on which TE(fn) tends to its liminf. After further extraction in the quenched convention, there is a sequence qj ↓ 0 such that the spectral 33 components of Jf qj have weak cylinder limits G(j) as n → ∞. Every weak cluster point of (G(j)) in L2(Π; ℓ2) equals ∇F. In particular, F belongs to the form domain of Proposition 5.1 and ∥∇F∥L2(Π;ℓ2) ≤ C  lim inf n→∞ TE(fn) 1/2 . (5.6) The constant is the same for all sequences with the stated size bounds.
